poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE MOMENTS ARE PAUSED WHEN THE STARS ALIGN FOR US
poetryFrame.rightVertical: A SIMPLE GESTURE CAN SHIFT EVERYTHING FOREVERMORE
poetryFrame.bottomLine: WE WERE ALWAYS MEANT TO BE FOUND HERE.
sonnetLines: A casual inquiry of the day's flight.
But thoughts drift far beyond the spoken word,
Into a space where feelings are preferred.
We trace the lines of what might come to be,
You cast a glow upon my darkest hours,
Like sudden bloom in fading evening flowers.
I confess the depth I cannot hide,
Where all my quiet affections reside.
Let time suspend its measured pace,
And hold this feeling in this sacred space.
My heart belongs to your electric grace,
